```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(enrichplot)
library(MOFA2)
library(ReactomePA)
library(KEGGREST)
library(ggplot2)
```

# load mofa moadel
```{r}
outfile <- file.path(getwd(), paste0("MOFA_model_15.hdf5"))
model <- load_model(outfile)
```

```{r}
threshold <- 0.8 # set mofa weight threshold
features <- c()
# load the transcriptomic feature weights from the important factors
weights <- as.data.frame(get_weights(model, views = "RNA", factors = c(2,4,5,12), abs = TRUE))
# loop through all important factors and extract the features that reach the threshold.
for (y in 1:4){
  for (x in 1:nrow(weights)){
    if (weights[x,y] > threshold){
      features <- c(features,rownames(weights[x,]))
    }
  }
}
#check for duplicates
RNA_features <- unique(features)
```

# check what features were extracted
```{r}
RNA_features
```

# load the transcriptomic suprvised dataset
```{r}
rna_supervised <- readRDS("RNA_supervised_preprocessed")
```

```{r}
genes_interest <- unique(RNA_features)           # MOFA-selected genes 
background_genes <- unique(rownames(rna_supervised))  # all genes used in MOFA
```


```{r}
# MSigDB Hallmark (SYMBOLs)
msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  as.data.frame()
# Hallmark ORA (MSigDB)
eh_Hallmark <- enricher(
  gene          = genes_interest,
  universe      = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE     = msig_h,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500
)
p <- dotplot(eh_Hallmark, title="MSigDB Hallmark")
#save plot
#ggsave("msigdb_hallmark_enrichment.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
p
```


```{r}
####################################################################
# GO enrichment (BP, MF, CC)
# Biological Process
ego_BP <- enrichGO(
  gene          = genes_interest,
  universe      = background_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,
  readable = TRUE
)

# Molecular Function
ego_MF <- enrichGO(
  gene          = genes_interest,
  universe      = background_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "MF",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500
)

# Cellular Component
ego_CC <- enrichGO(
  gene          = genes_interest,
  universe      = background_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "CC",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500
)
#save plots
p <- dotplot(ego_BP, title="GO: Biological Process")
p
#ggsave("gh_biological_process_enrichment.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p <- dotplot(ego_MF, title="GO: Molecular Function")
p
#ggsave("gh_molecular_function_enrichment.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

p <- dotplot(ego_CC, title="GO: Cellular Component")
p
#ggsave("go_cellular_component_enrichment.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#############################################################
#KEGG (requires Entrez IDs)

# We'll convert SYMBOLs to ENTREZ for these analyses.
gene_map <- bitr(genes_interest, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
bg_map   <- bitr(background_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
genes_entrez <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
bg_entrez    <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)


# KEGG pathway enrichment
ek <- enrichKEGG(
  gene          = genes_entrez,
  universe      = bg_entrez,
  organism      = "hsa",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 5000
)

########################################################################

dotplot(ek, title="KEGG Pathways")

```

```{r}
  gene          = genes_entrez,  # ENTREZ

  organism      = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 500,

dotplot(er_Reactome, title = "Reactome Pathways")

```

```{r}
gene_map <- bitr(genes_interest, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
bg_map   <- bitr(background_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
genes_entrez <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
bg_entrez    <- unique(bg_map$ENTREZID)

# Ensure ENTREZ IDs are character
genes_entrez <- as.character(unique(genes_entrez))
bg_entrez    <- as.character(unique(bg_entrez))

# ---------- Collect MEDICUS components ----------
# DISEASE (H numbers)
# get all disease terms
d_all <- keggList("disease") 
link_disease <- keggLink("disease", "hsa")        

# Build a TERM2GENE table for enrichment.
t2g_disease <- tibble(
  term   = sub("^ds:",  "", unname(link_disease)),
  gene   = sub("^hsa:", "", names(link_disease)),
  source = "DISEASE"
)
# Build a TERM2NAME table: mapping disease IDs to their descriptive names.
t2n_disease <- tibble(
  term   = names(d_all),
  name   = unname(d_all),
  source = "DISEASE"
)
#########################################################################################
# DRUG (D numbers) — use drug targets as gene sets
drug_all <- keggList("drug")                       
link_drug <- keggLink("drug", "hsa")               

# Build a TERM2GENE table for enrichment.
t2g_drug <- tibble(
  term   = sub("^dr:",  "", unname(link_drug)),
  gene   = sub("^hsa:", "", names(link_drug)),
  source = "DRUG"
)

# Build a TERM2NAME table: mapping drug IDs to their descriptive names.
t2n_drug <- tibble(
  term   = names(drug_all),
  name   = unname(drug_all),
  source = "DRUG"
)
###########################################################################################
# NETWORK (N numbers) — network variation maps, if gene links exist
network_all <- keggList("network")  
link_network <- keggLink("network", "hsa") 


# Build a TERM2GENE table for enrichment.
t2g_network <- tibble(
  term   = sub("^ne:",  "", unname(link_network)),
  gene   = sub("^hsa:", "", names(link_network)),
  source = "NETWORK"
)

# Build a TERM2NAME table: mapping network IDs to their descriptive names.
t2n_network <- tibble(
  term   = names(network_all),
  name   = unname(network_all),
  source = "NETWORK"
)

#################################################################################################
# ---------- Combine to form MEDICUS gene sets ----------
term2gene <- bind_rows(t2g_disease, t2g_drug, t2g_network) %>%
  distinct(term, gene, source)

term2name <- bind_rows(t2n_disease, t2n_drug, t2n_network) %>%
  semi_join(distinct(term2gene, term), by = "term") %>%
  distinct(term, name, source)
####################################################################################################
# ---------- Diagnostics ----------
# how many genes do we have that overlap with the genes in th medicus?
ov_list <- length(intersect(genes_entrez, term2gene$gene))
ov_bg   <- length(intersect(bg_entrez,    term2gene$gene))
cat("MEDICUS overlap list: Genes of interest", ov_list, " | Background:", ov_bg)

# ---------- Enrichment ----------
ed_med <- enricher(
  gene          = genes_entrez,
  universe      = bg_entrez,
  TERM2GENE = dplyr::select(term2gene, term, gene),
  TERM2NAME = dplyr::select(term2name, term, name),
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.20,
  minGSSize    = 10,
  maxGSSize    = 500

)

p <- dotplot(ed_med, title = "KEGG MEDICUS (Disease/Drug/Network)")
p
#save plot
#ggsave("medicus_enrichment.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
